_purpose: Purpose: machine-readable worker handoff contract. Audience: worker, parent renderer, and result validator. Injection: remove this top-level _purpose field before serializing the schema into worker-task.md. ready_for_review requests human review; it does not complete or approve the issue.

summary.description: Brief changes made or reason work could not proceed; not a completion claim.

tests.description: Actual commands or checks and their observed outcomes. State important checks not run and why.

blockers.description: Decisions, safety conflicts, or missing capabilities that prevent a reviewable handoff.
